summary: Nginx on node1 now returns HTTP 200 at http://10.100.81.10:6700/ and recovered successfully after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Installed and configured Nginx with a dedicated TCP 6700 server block
Assigned TCP 6700 to SELinux http_port_t while retaining enforcing mode
Added persistent PID-file labeling needed for reliable startup on RHEL 7
Restarted node1 once and verified recovery

evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Both before and after reboot, Nginx was active and enabled, listening on TCP 6700, passed configuration validation, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with the expected body through NODE_IP.
TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t, allowed by runtime and permanent firewalld policy, and remained effective after reboot with SELinux enforcing.

Healthy baseline boot ID 2fc81aed-3ce8-4a35-8f4c-b73206afa45f was captured, the restart was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 541233e0-eca0-416f-8fc8-bcbd008286e2, and full Nginx/listener/security-policy/HTTP recovery was proven.
